  <text x="20" y="17" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">9:41</text>
  <text x="58" y="68" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Privacy & Policy</text>
  <text x="28" y="141" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10.5" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">
    <tspan x="28" dy="0" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">1. Information we collect</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">We collect information you provide when you create an account, order food,</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">contact support, or join the mint community. This may include your name, email</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">address, phone number, delivery details, preferences, and payment information.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="29" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">2. How we use information</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">Your information helps us process orders, connect customers with vendors,</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">personalize recommendations, improve safety, and provide account assistance.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">We may also use information to send service updates and relevant notifications.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="29" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">3. Vendor information</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">Vendors may provide business details, menus, operating hours, allergen notes,</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">and fulfillment information. We use these details to display listings, support</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">orders, verify marketplace activity, and improve the vendor experience.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="29" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">4. Sharing information</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">We share only what is needed to complete an order, including relevant details</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">with the selected vendor, delivery partners, payment providers, and service</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">providers. We do not sell personal information for unrelated advertising.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="29" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">5. Data protection</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">protect account and vendor data. No online service can guarantee absolute security.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="29" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">6. Your choices</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">You can review or update account details, manage notifications, and request</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">access, correction, or deletion of eligible information through support.</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="29" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">7. Policy updates</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="17">We may update this policy as our services change. The latest version will be</tspan>
    <tspan x="28" dy="15">made available in the app, with the effective date shown when changes apply.</tspan>
  </text>
